featureTour.subtitle: Quick tour of features you'll want to know about.

custom.title: Add custom cards
custom.body: You have the option to add custom sentences you want to learn. You can also auto generate audio and translation in seconds.

import.title: Bulk import from CSV
import.body: Drag in a list of sentences and we'll fan them out into translations + audio for every language in your course.

radio.title: Radio mode for passive listening
radio.body: Set it and forget it — your cards play on loop in the background, without affecting your spaced-repetition schedule.

stats.title: Detailed stats track everything
stats.body: Streak, words learned, time spent, and a calendar heatmap so you can see your habit forming.

multilang.title: Multiple languages
multilang.body: On Pro you can also add a third language to your flashcards — handy if you want to learn multiple languages at once, or keep refreshing two languages you already know at the same time.

planPick.title: Thank you for joining
planPick.subtitle: Try Basic or Pro free for 21 days — no commitment. You can change or cancel anytime.

difficulty.title: How much do you already know?

elementary.title: Basic
elementary.description: I know the most common words

welcomeAudio.title: Welcome to Audio Review
welcomeAudio.description: In this mode you can review sentences hands-off. The texts are read aloud automatically. Let's walk through how it works.

welcomeFull.title: Welcome to Full Review
welcomeFull.description: In this mode you actively practise writing and get instant feedback. Let's walk through how it works.

card.title: The card
card.descriptionAudio: Each card shows a sentence in the languages you're learning. The target language is hidden until you reveal it.
card.descriptionFull: Each card shows a sentence in the languages you're learning. You'll type the translation and check yourself.

reveal.title: Reveal the translation
reveal.description: The target translation is hidden by default. Tap it to reveal, or just listen to the audio — after a short pause it reveals automatically. Try answering from memory first.

input.title: Type your translation
input.description: Type the target-language translation here and hit submit. You'll get instant feedback on each word.

audioControls.title: Audio plays automatically
audioControls.description: Audio plays the base language first, pauses for you to think, then plays the target. Restart, play / pause, or skip to the next card here.

audioPlay.title: Press play to start
audioPlay.description: Audio is paused right now while we walk you through the lesson. Press play whenever you're ready to hear the first sentence.

rating.title: Rate how well you knew it
rating.descriptionAudio: Each card is repeated a few times before it enters spaced repetition. Still learning keeps it in the warm-up rotation. Understood means you know it — skip the warm-up and start spaced repetition right away. After a few reviews you'll see Again / Hard / Good / Easy.
rating.descriptionFull: After every answer, rate how well you knew it. Again means you didn't know it — the card comes back quickly. Hard, Good, and Easy push the next review further out. Be honest — over-rating a card you didn't really know will haunt you later.

autoAdd.title: Adding cards
autoAdd.description: By default new cards are added automatically as the ones you have run out — everything is optimised for you using spaced repetition. This avoids cramming and takes care of pacing for you. You do not need to worry about when to add new cards.

welcome.title: Switched to Audio Review
welcome.description: You'll listen first and reveal the translation after. Here's what changes.

welcome.title: Switched to Full Review
welcome.description: You'll type the translation yourself and get instant feedback. Here's what changes.

cardActions.title: Card options
cardActions.description: Star a card to favourite it, mark it as mastered (it stops appearing in review), hide it from your deck, or edit/delete it. Use these whenever a card is too easy, too hard, or just wrong for you.

wordTap.title: Tap any word
wordTap.description: Tap a word in the target sentence to ask the chat what it means. The chat can also create a new flashcard for it on the spot.

chat.title: Your AI language tutor
chat.description: The chat is a tutor that knows the language you're learning. Ask why a sentence is phrased a certain way, get grammar explained at your level, request examples, or have the chat turn an idea into a new flashcard — translation and audio are generated automatically so the card is ready to study.

learnNew.title: Learn New
learnNew.description: Picks fresh sentences you haven't seen yet — perfect when you want to grow your vocabulary.

learnAndReview.title: Review + Learn
learnAndReview.description: Mixes new sentences with cards due for spaced repetition, so you keep what you've learned while picking up more.

radioMode.title: Radio
radioMode.description: Audio-only background playback — your cards loop hands-free without affecting their spaced-repetition schedule. Only available in audio mode.

reviewModeToggle.title: Audio vs Full Review
reviewModeToggle.description: Switch between Audio (hear the sentence and translate in your head) and Full (type the translation and get instant feedback).

contentSource.title: Pick your source
contentSource.description: Choose whether to study only premade sentences, only your own custom cards, or both at once.

difficultySelection.title: Difficulty Selection
difficultySelection.description: Here you can select your difficulty. Each difficulty is a collection of sentences for you to learn. They have been chosen based on word frequency such that you learn the most common words first. You can click on a collection to preview the upcoming sentences. Once you are ready, start with one of the learning modes.

welcome.title: Welcome to Audio Review
welcome.description: In this mode you can review sentences hands-off. The texts are read aloud automatically and it proceeds to the next sentence automatically. You can adjust the timing in the settings.

card.title: The Sentence
card.description: This sentence shows the texts in the languages you are learning. You can add more languages to the course later if you want.

targetText.title: Target Text and Audio
targetText.description: The target translation is hidden by default. It will be unblurred automatically or if you click on it. You can also play audio by clicking on the audio button.

rating.title: Rate Your Recall
rating.description: Each sentence is shown an initial number of times before spaced repetition starts. "Understood" skips the rest of those initial reviews. After that, you'll see more detailed ratings: Again, Hard, Good, Easy. Above the buttons you can see roughly when the sentence will be shown again.

audioControls.title: Audio Playing
audioControls.description: By default the audio is played automatically. First the base audio, then there is a pause for you to think and then the target audio is played before automatically proceeding to the next sentence.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Here you can change playback speed, language order, auto-advance, whether to hide or blur the target text, how many initial reviews each sentence gets and more.

welcome.title: Welcome to Full Review
welcome.description: In this mode you actively practice writing and get instant feedback.

card.title: The Sentence
card.description: The sentence in this mode shows the target and base languages and allows you to type in the translations.

input.title: Enter Your Translation
input.description: Here you enter the translation. You can also listen to the audio of the target language before typing it in.

rating.title: Rate Your Answer
rating.description: After viewing the feedback, rate how well you recalled: Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. This drives the spaced repetition schedule.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Here you can customize your settings. You can switch between review modes and adjust audio settings.

chat.title: Chat Assistant
chat.description: Use the chat to ask about grammar, get explanations, or create new sentences. The AI assistant is here to help you learn!
